LQ.name: Load Quality
LQ.interpretation: Quality of current load balance according to configured ACWR heuristic.

REC.name: Recovery
REC.interpretation: Recovery component directly inherited from deterministic daily readiness.

CAP.name: Capacity
CAP.interpretation: Observed performed-capacity proxy based on recent activity duration relative to the user's prior baseline.

VS.name: Vital Stability
VS.interpretation: Stability of available physiological signals relative to the user's recent personal baseline.

known_overlap_disclosure.LQ_and_REC: REC may already include a small load-balance contribution through readiness. This overlap must remain visible for the later weighting module.
known_overlap_disclosure.REC_and_VS: REC and VS may use related physiological signals, but REC represents readiness scoring while VS represents baseline stability.

limitations: Component scores are heuristic decision-support measures.
They are not professional training prescriptions.
Weights and final PWS are intentionally not computed in this module.
